Name: PBC - Sinnoh
Author: netherphnx
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
All the Sinnoh pokemon for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47809]Pokemon Battle Companions[/url]

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Extract in the Stardew Valley Mod's Folder

[b]Main features[/b]
This is a content pack for PBC, and it needs that mod to function. Installing this on its own will do nothing.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47809]Pokemon Battle Companions[/url]

Manifest.Name: Pokémon Battle Companions — Sinnoh
Manifest.Description: Sinnoh (Generation 4) species pack for Pokémon Battle Companions. Adds the 107 Sinnoh Pokémon (Turtwig through Arceus). Sprites and portraits courtesy of pmdcollab.org contributors (CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0).
